record.original_question: Can the above theory for the analytic group actions be generalized to the case of codimension 1 real analytic foliations?

evidence.quote: Question 8.1. Can the above theory for the analytic group actions be generalized to the case of codimension 1 real analytic foliations?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)_0$ denote the identity component of the group of real analytic diffeomorphisms of a closed real analytic manifold $M$, equipped with its natural topology. A body of results is known concerning real analytic group actions on manifolds, including perfectness/simplicity results for $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}(M)_0$ for certain manifolds $M$ (for example $S^1$ and various low-dimensional manifolds admitting suitable circle actions), and rigidity/structure theorems for real analytic actions of finitely generated groups, governing the structure of orbits, exceptional minimal sets, and associated cohomological invariants.

A codimension one real analytic foliation $\mathcal F$ on a closed real analytic manifold $M$ is a partition of $M$ into immersed real analytic hypersurfaces (leaves) given locally as the level sets of a submersion to $\mathbb R$, with transition data being real analytic. The holonomy pseudogroup of $\mathcal F$ is a pseudogroup of local real analytic diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb R$ (or of a 1-manifold transverse to the foliation).

Problem. Develop, for codimension one real analytic foliations $\mathcal F$ on closed real analytic manifolds, an analogue of the structure theory available for real analytic group actions. In particular, do the known structural and rigidity results for real analytic group actions (perfectness/simplicity of identity components of analytic diffeomorphism groups; classification of minimal sets; constraints on holonomy and on associated cohomological invariants such as powers of the Euler class) admit natural generalizations in which the role of the group action is played by the holonomy pseudogroup of $\mathcal F$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a 2024 problem list on foliations and diffeomorphism groups. Web search did not surface any subsequent work claiming to have generalized the analytic group-action theory (e.g., perfectness of Diff^ω_0 and rigidity of analytic actions) to codimension one real analytic foliations. The status thus appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the group of real analytic diffeomorphisms (Tsuboi)
status_evidence.snippet: Tsuboi shows perfectness of the identity component of the group of real analytic diffeomorphisms for various manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: This is part of the 'theory for analytic group actions' the question proposes to generalize.

status_evidence.title: Codimension one minimal foliations and the fundamental groups of leaves
status_evidence.snippet: Study of transversely real-analytic codimension one foliations.
status_evidence.claim: Related background on codimension-one real analytic foliations; no general analytic-group-action analogue is established.
